Package ke.ric.renderer.api

Record Class CaptureProvenance

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
ke.ric.renderer.api.CaptureProvenance
Record Components:
worldId - stable Bukkit world UUID
worldName - captured world name
worldEnvironment - captured world environment identifier
sourceCamera - original source camera, with angles in radians
capturedAt - wall-clock capture timestamp
startedNanos - monotonic time at the start of world evidence capture
completedNanos - monotonic time at the end of world evidence capture
fullTime - captured world time including elapsed days
timeOfDay - captured day ticks in 0..23999
weather - captured local precipitation, including rain versus snow
thundering - captured thunder state
cameraBiome - captured camera biome identifier
public record CaptureProvenance(UUID worldId, String worldName, String worldEnvironment, SceneCamera sourceCamera, Instant capturedAt, long startedNanos, long completedNanos, long fullTime, long timeOfDay, Weather weather, boolean thundering, String cameraBiome) extends Record
Immutable facts from the original capture, retained unchanged by scene derivation and camera reuse. Rendered time/weather overrides do not rewrite these facts. Compare RenderedFrame.effectiveCamera() with sourceCamera to inspect a reframed camera.

A batched capture covers an interval, not one instant. Monotonic nanosecond values are useful for ages and durations only in the same server process; capturedAt provides a wall-clock label. Camera biome and precipitation describe the source camera's captured environment.
